description: Fetch the curated daily agentic-web news and adoption digest for a YYYY-MM-DD date (defaults to latest). Returns { version, date, url, generated_at, window, headline, lede, items, stats, record_changes, previous, method, license }; pass list: true to return { latest, count, digests, page }, or compact: true (alias: include_stats: false) to omit the census stats block. Use digest for daily narrative summaries; use changes for raw field-level diffs.
name: digest
